sections.html: This species occurs along the Pacific coast from Ecuador to Nicaragua.

Specific information on keeping this species is not yet available, but it will probably not differ substantially from that for other fiddler crabs. The aquarium should have a large land area on which the fiddler crabs preferably stay, as well as a water area with shallow water.
They have no high requirements regarding food; nearly every food offered is eaten greedily.
In January 2006 the fiddler crab Uca ornata was imported to Germany for the first time. Only a few animals were obtained from Ecuador, and further imports of this species are hoped for.
